newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Two dead, two orphaned in Australia lightning strike.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, two orphaned in Australia lightning strike.

text.p: Lightning killed an Australian couple on Monday as their two young sons looked on during a picnic in the southern city of Geelong, police said.

The family and friends had taken shelter in a metal-roofed rotunda after a storm broke out while they were picnicking in a public park. The bolt of lightning struck when the group were in the rotunda, a police spokesman told Reuters.
"We have had a very, very traumatic scene. It's been absolute chaos," said Inspector Tim Attrill of Geelong police.

The woman died instantly and attempts at the scene to revive her husband failed, he said. A second woman was resuscitated and taken to hospital in critical condition, while others suffered burned feet, chest pain and trauma.
"Two little boys aged 10 and 12 are now orphaned and were at the scene when their parents were killed," Attrill said. He described the park's rotunda as a "perfect conductor".
Police said it was not clear whether the children were in the rotunda or close by.
